The main takeaway from our work is that

the compositions of magmatic sulfide ore are not random, but are controlled by a few fundamental processes, including: (1) the relative volumes of the immiscible sulfides and slags, (2) the extent of sulfide–slag mixing, and (3) the extent of post-depositional re-equilibration of the sulfide ore with the silicate host.
